name: Reborn as Driller
desc:
Welcome to Drill Mining Simulator! ⭐ UPDATE EVERY WEEKEND

⛏️ Grab your drill and start mining straight down!
💥 Break through layers of earth and reach the bottom!
🏆 Every time you reach the end, earn +1 Win!
💰 Hatch pets to boost your cash and mine faster!
⚡ Upgrade your drill, unlock better tools, and become the best digger!
🎯 Compete with others and climb the leaderboards!

🚀 Like & Favorite for updates with exciting features and content!

🌟 Can you collect the most Wins and become the ultimate driller? Start now!
